title: PackageScoState
description: Current confirmed run-time state for one registration and activity occurrence.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

registration_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

occurrence_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

launch_count.description: Count of activated sessions for this occurrence.

total_time_ms.description: Exact fixed-unit millisecond projection only when duration has no unresolved calendar components.

completion_status.description: Last accepted raw completion token, when supported.

success_status.description: Last accepted raw success token, when supported.

state_revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision used for compare-and-swap.

updated_at.description: UTC time of last durably accepted mutation.

activity_attempt_id.description: Activity attempt whose RTE model this is.

duration_total.description: Lossless duration sum. Preserve calendar components separately from fixed elapsed units.

x-invariants: A read of cached values is not evidence of commit.
Only the runtime owner can write after valid edition checks.
A new attempt within an existing registration starts from edition defaults. A resumed attempt reuses its own state. Preview, browse and review state never replaces official attempt evidence.
